mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consistent month-over-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a single month indicates supply-side constraints, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions impact corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a single month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector contributes positively to GDP.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) for three consecutive months signals a disinflationary environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real income and purchasing power increase.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from robust economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 is above its 12-month moving average, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
